notes.title: Big update
notes.notes:
Hey guys. I have big update for you. A lot of things were improved in the game and list of some changes i will put here:


 Added new company logo
 Changed main menu. It was fully refactored
 Were removed black lines for all screens that is not 16:9 format
 Added new camera logic. Now it's much smoother and better
 Level 3 - added new beautiful background instead of old pixelated
 Level 7 - added new beautiful background instead of old pixelated
 Some animations were improved
 Pause menu was fixed - bug with displaying menu
  Plane levels - fixed d-pad navigation bug
  And many more small updates


Thank you that you bought the game and supported me, I appreciated it a lot and thanks for your feedbacks.  You are the best
